{{Top|leg}}
'''Beta group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|group]] of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During the [[Sepan campaign]], they fought off [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] ships during the [[Raid on the Tropsobor|raid on]] the ''[[Tropsobor]]'', protecting several flights of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s.
